rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 10 and 11: a real constraint the prototype cannot express, such as cross-service behaviour, overrides the prototype default; here the backend sends a species' display text, and not its code, to the downstream GBN-AG payload as its scientificName (repo-backend-p6-108, repo-backend-p6-126), so the Latin name is data another service receives, not copy the prototype can choose freely.
outcome: Correct DR2.1's species data rather than copy it: the horse species reads 'Equus caballus' and the mule 'Eq caballus*asinus', and Other live mammals holds a single 'Other Mammalia' (Other mammal) entry. The species display text is what the backend sends downstream as the GBN-AG scientificName, with no species code beside it, so a misspelt Latin name would reach the receiving service as a wrong scientific name, and two entries that differ only in a capital letter would reach it as the same species. The prototype's own id (horse-equus-caballus) already spells the name correctly. Every other species name, common name and code is exactly as DR2.1 gives it.
